QuestInfo.name: A Curse in Time
QuestInfo.0: #p2411010# believes that #p2411011# was cursed by the time relic. Alpha and Beta knew they would need to speak with the priests in the Temple of Time to confirm his suspicions...
QuestInfo.1: With the truth that #p2411011# had definitely been cursed by the relic, #p2400000# put out the idea that the relic only wanted to be handled by its owner. With the strange notion of a relic having feeling in their heads, the duo set back to visit #b#p2411010##k in #b#m321100000##k #b#MDmap321190300##k.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta returned to #p2411010# and explained how to break the curse. As luck would have it, this was one of #p2411010#'s specialties! #p2400005# was quite impressed.

npc.0: This #b#p2411010##k person that you talked to in #b#m321100000##k is a magician, yes? Perhaps he knows something about breaking curses? I fear this one is quite advanced.
